messages.author: a3ea45e87285d820
messages.subject: Re: [dartR] Re: Input DART DATA TO dartR package
parts:
Hi Sang,

This is a general issue with loading packages into R. In this case, you are having difficulty loading adegenet.

When the system gives you an error like "there is no package called units", you will need to load this manually, using (in this case)

load.packages("units")
library(units)

then go back to the start.

For reasons beyond me, this issue raises its ugly head for some users of R and not others. So I cannot predict what will happen in the future regarding other packages failing to load.

So, once you have 'units' loaded, try again, then repeat this process for any packages that fail to load.

Bestus

A
